description: ScBaNa(BO₃)₂ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3 space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one B and six equivalent O atoms. The Na-B bond length is 2.91 Å. There are three shorter (2.48 Å) and three longer (2.86 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ba is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are six shorter (2.81 Å) and three longer (2.85 Å) Ba-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Sc sites. In the first Sc site, Sc is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Sc-O bond lengths are 2.13 Å. In the second Sc site, Sc is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Sc-O bond lengths are 2.11 Å. There are two inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and three equivalent O atoms. All B-O bond lengths are 1.39 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All B-O bond lengths are 1.38 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ba, one Sc, and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ba, one Sc, and one B atom.
